en: A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young woman in elaborate traditional attire. She wears richly patterned embroidered clothing, multiple necklaces and bracelets, and large disk-shaped earrings. A cloth head covering or headdress is wrapped around her head. She is seated with hands on her hips, looking intently to the side. The background is plain and neutral. Small handwritten text and numbering appear near the bottom edge of the image, suggesting it was produced as an ethnographic postcard.
